notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Egg or a creature with changeling.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Egg or a nontoken creature with changeling.
When the creature dies, Atla Palani and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing the creature from the top of your library and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing one damage to any target.
Repeat.
